dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you want the frog for?

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I wanna give him to my little sister to play with.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: My sister is that girl over there, the one who is always trying to catch her shadow... even though you can't catch your shadow. I don't get why she likes to do that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: Maybe she just feels bored. At least if I catch her a frog, chasing him will be more fun than chasing her shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you play with her?

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I think she doesn't like me very much. She doesn't wanna listen to anything I say, let alone play with me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Zuo
dialogues.text: I don't get it, I'm always trying my bestest to find her things she wants, so why won't she be happy with me?
